title: Whittier Drive and Coastal Alaska Full Day Adventure
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the stunning landscapes of Alaska on a full-day tour through Whittier and along the scenic Seward Highway. Led by local guides, this immersive journey showcases breathtaking mountain views, tranquil lakes, and charming towns, all while delving into Alaska's rich history. Highlights include a visit to Portage Lake, a hike to accessible glaciers, and the chance to explore the remnants of a WWII military base. Perfect for outdoor enthusiasts and nature lovers, this trip promises a blend of adventure and discovery with several stops along the way.

- Full-day tour from Anchorage, lasting approximately 10 hours
- Explore Portage Lake and Glacier with hiking options
- Visit historical sites and enjoy scenic views along Seward Highway
- Group size limited to six for a more personalized experience
